source_lookup: Resolve source_page below against source_bundle_url. Match full_name in that compact page and its batch JSON for immutable revision, README/license-file hashes, recent activity, sampled issues and bank joins. Supplemental names use supplemental-receipts.json.
score_policy: 0-5 provisional documentation-based judgments for the named bounded role, not a global ranking. Health/adoption remain null because a robust issue-response/bus-factor assessment and current verified dependence were not completed. Missing is not zero. No aggregate score is calculated.
bank_policy: ALREADY IN THE BANK means an exact-name/known-alias join to one or more of four published layers: best, liftable, adoption, product shelf. NEW means absent from those compared layers, not proved absent from the unpublished identity database or all other exports.
license_policy: Root-file evidence only; NOASSERTION and null remain unresolved. Directory/dependency/edition rights are not cleared. License does not determine these technical selection verdicts.
adopt_policy: ADOPT means proposed use of the existing component in a bounded evaluation, not admitted, installed, safe for money, or confirmed to work as-is in this assembly.
local_policy: local_role is a documentation-based deployment hypothesis. All measured resource floors and integrated offline tests remain unknown. A local SDK does not self-host its external broker/data service.
